summary: Escalade Inc. filed an 8-K to report first-quarter 2026 earnings and a quarterly dividend. The press release disclosed net sales of $55.8 million (up 0.6%), operating income of $5.8 million (up 59.8%), and net income of $4.4 million ($0.32 EPS). Separately, the board approved a $0.1525 per share dividend payable July 13, 2026 to holders of record July 6, 2026. There is no event that qualifies as a special situation; this is a routine earnings and dividend announcement. No deal terms apply.
